chapters.title: Chapter 206 High-level cooperation?
paragraphs: In the hotel's private room, a young man in his twenties was waiting in a suit. When he saw Zhao An coming in with a beautiful woman in his arms, he immediately stood up, smiled gently, and walked over with both hands to shake hands, "Welcome, welcome, please sit here, Mr. Zhao. I'm Liu Ke, very happy to meet Mr. Zhao, please sit down."
Zhao An also stretched out his hand and shook hands with the other party, "Hello, Liu Ke, a nice name."

"Haha, thank you for exaggerating. Please sit down. I heard that Mr. Zhao likes light dishes, so I took the initiative to order a small Manchu and Han banquet, I hope it will suit your taste." Liu Ke said with a smile, a typical standard businessman, so-called not to hit a smiling person, the other party was smiling, it seemed a bit difficult to hit him.

"Okay, no more small talk. I hope I can briefly explain my purpose. If we get along well, there will be plenty of dinners in the future. If we don't, there will be no more talk. Tell me why you are here!" Zhao An hugged the class beauty and felt the excitement of the woman in his arms, which was the look after he had kissed her thigh.
"How about I work with Mr. Zhao to develop your live broadcast field?" Liu Ke also said his intention with a smile.

"I don't need to share my ideas with you, nor do I need to share my wealth with you. Everyone knows the dividends of live broadcasting. Tens of billions a day is not a problem, provided that you have the conditions and capital. What qualifications do you have to talk to me about cooperation? Just relying on the little relationship in your family? It's okay to call the wind and rain in front of ordinary people, but it doesn't work with me." Zhao An said lightly, drinking from the teacup.
Liu Ke laughed heartily, took out a cigarette and handed it over, "Does Mr. Zhao smoke?"

Zhao An waved his hand, "I don't smoke this kind of cigarettes, just call me Zhao An, no need for such hypocritical titles." After that, he took out a medicinal cigarette and lit it. This kind of cigarette that only he could make, the whole room was filled with the rich aroma of medicinal materials, the strong smell of Chinese medicine!
Liu Ke took a deep breath, his eyes lit up, "Is this tobacco still for sale?"

"No, the exclusive secret recipe is not passed on to others." Zhao An said lightly, he could feel the admiring eyes from the class flower. The stronger the strength shown, the stronger the woman's sense of dependence. Only strong men can have these beautiful women, the law of the jungle is the truth, the strong can always get more.

Liu Ke was stunned for a moment, his eyes flashed with a thoughtful light, he had to re-examine the other party. A cigarette is not a problem, the problem is that there are people who can have such craftsmanship, even with his vision, he doesn't know where to produce it. If he knew, it is estimated that the young masters of the upper class would have started smoking it long ago.
"One person can't make all the money in the live broadcast business. One more ally means one more way out, right?"

"You can do it yourself, you don't have to cooperate with me. My company won't let other people participate. In my opinion, no one is qualified. You are no exception. Do you know what kind of pressure you will face in the future? You don't understand at all. This is just a quick money. In the final analysis, it is a star-making movement, a platform that creates countless stars and Internet celebrities. Zero threshold, as long as one person can become an Internet celebrity, a star. You can't even see through this. I doubt whether your IQ will make you a pig teammate. Sorry, I speak so straightforwardly, otherwise I wouldn't start a business alone, but it doesn't matter. For me, this is easier." Zhao An began to pretend and release smoke bombs, but he didn't say it clearly.

But Liu Ke could feel that there must be a big background behind the other party. The top big families were lurking silently. He could only see some other people in the open, and didn't know who was whose in secret.

"You are really a genius. You know that stars are just a plaything for us." Liu Ke also said very clearly. Indeed, for capitalists, they can play with stars if they have money. The so-called stars are just high-end prostitutes.

"I don't want to talk about this issue. Are you showing off your superiority? Like those guys, they are all idiots. Do you think that you can show off your superiority just because you were born in a better place?" Zhao An's expression gradually became disdainful, with a hint of teasing in his eyes.

Liu Ke's expression also changed, and his tone was a little cold, "What do you want to say? Let's not talk about anything else. As long as you can participate in the business here, I can help you settle other things."

"Oh, really? No, I just need to pay taxes on time. Do you think anyone can stop me? Haha, don't be silly, the live broadcast industry will never let you interfere." Zhao An's expression was extremely arrogant. Live broadcast is one of his entertainment factories. It is used to create stars, to train celebrity female anchors, and then provide a place for his own pleasure. How could he let others interfere?
"Then there's nothing to talk about?" Liu Ke raised his eyebrows, and the talks broke down.

"Of course, I'll be the only one doing the live broadcast business, but I still need people to cooperate in many areas. Money is endless, and money is just a number to me. I don't need to make too much money, and being too smart and performing too well is not a good thing. At least I like my current life, free and easy." Zhao An picked up the red wine and raised the glass.

Liu Ke's eyes lit up, and he immediately picked up the wine glass and clinked it with Zhao An, "Please give me more advice, Mr. Zhao, if there is any way to make money, please give me some advice, and I will do my best to repay you!"

"Now is the Internet age. If things on the Internet want to become reality, they need to go through logistics and transportation. Do you understand this?" Zhao An started eating, not polite at all. Patting the class flower's hips, Liao Ruoxia also understood and started eating. She just needed to be a vase and give the man face.

In fact, Liao Ruoxia was still very interested in the conversation between the two, at least it let her know how powerful Zhao An's background was. The stronger Zhao An is, the more stable she will be, and she will know her asking price.

Being a virgin, plus the combination of mother and daughter, Liao Ruoxia can get a high score in Zhao An's heart. Although she is a little money-worshipping, isn't it normal for beautiful women to be money-worshipping? Don't accuse others of worshipping money. As long as you have money, the one who licks your boots is the class flower, not yourself as a loser. You should blame yourself for not having money. Love is really ridiculous.

chapters.title: Chapter 207 Business Layout
paragraphs: Liu Ke's eyes lit up, "I'd like to hear more!" After saying that, he stood up and poured wine for the other party. As for the background forces behind him, since he couldn't find out, he would put it aside for now. Making money is the most important thing, and he doesn't believe that the other party is from a single-parent family. Maybe it's a branch of a big family. After all, men are always more romantic, flirting with women, and it's possible that they accidentally kill people.

As long as they have the ability, they can come back to contribute to the family. If they don't have the ability, they will fend for themselves. This is obviously the case, but it's uncertain which family Zhao An is with. No matter which one, Liu Ke can't afford to offend them. If they can't afford to offend, then cooperate. If they can't cooperate, don't make enemies.

"Stop talking nonsense. When setting up a logistics company, I want half of the shares, and the remaining half belongs to others. In addition, I will send people to conduct regular financial checks. I will not manage the specific operations, you will be responsible, and I will tell you how to do it. Do you understand? If you don't have a brain, then be diligent and you can still make money. The other 50% is not yours, but yours and other partners. Any objections?" Zhao An said lightly.

"Okay, no problem. I toast you a glass, and we have a happy cooperation in the future." Liu Ke would naturally not refuse such a good thing. It sounds like he suffered a loss, but he also has people under him. He can also be a hands-off boss, and the young master will not do it himself. I am not afraid of hardship or fatigue, but I am afraid of hardship and fatigue and not making money.

"The biggest fear of logistics companies is lack of traffic. There is no need to worry about this. Orders will never decrease, but will only increase. Talent is the most critical, and you will not be the only shareholder in the future. Your shares will be continuously diluted, while wealth will continue to rise. First, make the things well. You have the information of those paper towel factories. Send someone to make a summary of the sales of each brand, the location of the things, the impact on sales, etc. Give these sales data to one of the big brands and tell them to let us do the transportation. We will provide such reports to them every month in the future. If they disagree, then just say bluntly that this document will be given to their competitors!" Zhao An talked while eating.
This made Liu Ke's eyes brighter and brighter. He looked at Zhao An with admiration and fear in his eyes, "I understand. Any other instructions?"

"Do you have anyone on the team?" Zhao An said without even looking up. He picked up a glass of red wine, poured himself another glass, and clinked glasses with the class flower, as if he had treated this place as a date.

The class beauty also clinked her wine glass with Zhao An. This feeling was really good, and she felt more and more like an upper-class person. Sometimes Liao Ruoxia felt that it was not a bad thing for her father to have an accident. At least now she and her mother Qin Xue were living better. Her mother was also pregnant, and she had regained the passion of her youth. There was nothing wrong with that.
Liu Ke shook his head, "I can only find a few cars, which may not be enough."

"Okay, I'll leave the order to you. This method can be used against any company. It's an equal exchange. We only need to spend a little time on this side. This is called making money out of nothing. The second problem is that there are some small rental trucks outside the city and suburbs. These vehicles can't receive a few orders all day long. We can do business with them, they listen to us, and then we give them orders to run. If they can run, they can make money, and generally they won't refuse. Who would leave money to waste?" Zhao An quickly finished most of the food.

"Okay, both methods are handed over to you. You have to handle the rest of the specific implementation. Don't let me down. There are a lot of investors behind you who are ready to cooperate with me. I will only cooperate with useful people. You try to show your value, otherwise I can't guarantee that I will kick you out. If you don't know how to do it, I can teach you, but if you can't learn it, then I'm sorry. Survival of the fittest, I hope you understand this principle. Doing business is to make money, not charity, understand?" Zhao An always maintained a high attitude.
This suppressed Liu Ke's momentum from the beginning. Cooperation between young masters is not so simple. Whoever takes the initiative will have a better advantage. This is a fact.
"Understand, I will definitely work hard, Mr. Zhao, I'll toast you a glass, you can do whatever you want." Liu Ke picked up the glass and took a sip.

After eating and drinking, it was already past six o'clock. Zhao An hugged the class flower and returned to the class flower's house. As soon as he entered the door, he saw Qin Xue watching TV, which showed some modern baby care knowledge.

Seeing Zhao An coming, Qin Xue was slightly stunned, then stood up and went to greet her man in six-centimeter high-heeled sandals, "Husband, you are here? Have you eaten? I'll make something for you."

"Mom is so annoying. She forgot her daughter after having a husband. Hehe, this is also my husband, the husband of our mother and daughter!" Liao Ruoxia said a little drunkenly, smiling like a flower. Anyway, she had served Zhao An together in bed for countless times, and she had no shyness at all. Moreover, her mother was pregnant with Zhao An's child, which was a very worthy thing for her to celebrate. With children, at least with Zhao An's personality, he would not abandon them.
"Have you drunk?" Qin Xue frowned and wanted to say something, but finally didn't say it. The child has grown up, so let her make her own decision.

"I went to discuss some business, and I happened to meet you, so I took Ruoxia to see the world. In the future, my company will definitely let you help manage it. If you can do that, just look at your own. Or I have a beauty mall, you can also choose. Anyway, there are many companies, and you won't be too bored if I give you something to do. I will guarantee the funds and other things. You just need to give birth to the baby obediently." Zhao An's expression became more and more lewd. It's a sense of accomplishment to support women and make them pregnant, isn't it?
"I know, husband, I'll make you some sobering soup." Qin Xue said gently. For Zhao An, she really loves him. Even pregnant with a child, how can she have no feelings.
Zhao An hugged Liao Ruoxia and walked into the room, "You do it, I'll have a shot first, I can't stand it anymore!"

Soon, the room was filled with the woman's high-pitched moans. Liao Ruoxia didn't suppress herself at all. If it weren't for the good sound insulation, the whole community would probably hear her moans.
